name: brand-not-embedded
body: kalide's own brand collateral (the `brand/` files: mark, wordmark, PNG exports) must stay repository/documentation-only: it must never be go:embed'ed into the binary, never placed under `internal/assets`, and never referenced from the served deck/error/gallery page shells or the `kalide init` seed. This reinforces global.constraint.go-static-embedded-binary and global.constraint.no-embedded-template-assets ("the core must remain unbranded"), applying them to kalide's own identity, not only to template/EY branding.
